name: Mydrannul
summary: At the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus, Mydrannul keeps basic supplies ready for sentinels, soldiers, and visitors.

sections.title: Supplies of the Warrior's Terrace
sections.body: Mydrannul tends a supply stall among the Warrior's Terrace military pavilions and training grounds. There, Darnassus's defenders and travelers find everyday field gear, from ammunition for archers and gunners to throwing blades, flint, pouches, and simple rations. Sentinels and trainees preparing for duty on Teldrassil can gather the sundries they need.

faq.answer: Mydrannul can be found in the Warrior's Terrace, Darnassus's southeastern martial district on the crown of Teldrassil.
Mydrannul sells containers, simple rations, drink, flint and tinder, throwing weapons, arrows, and bullets.
Yes. Mydrannul sends adventurers to his friend Nessa Shadowsong, a fishing merchant in Rut'theran Village. She needs a parcel carried to Darkshore.

angles.text: As a night elf training in Darnassus, you can find everyday equipment and arrows from Mydrannul to keep Sentinels supplied.
As an Alliance traveler arriving on Teldrassil, you can find basic packs, ammunition, and field rations at Mydrannul's stall in the Warrior's Terrace.
